title: Disposition Drag Preserves Layout Gap
description: When dragging a disposition, all other dispositions must remain in the same spot; leave a gap of exactly the same original size where the dragged disposition was.
summary:
Dragging a disposition no longer shifts siblings or vacates its original slot.

Canvas: the wrapper stays on the declared frame (layout gap preserved); live drag/resize is applied on the content layer via canvasDispositionDragContentStyle.

Flow: pixel-offset translate moved to content; flowDispositionReserveStyle keeps the wrapper footprint while ink/chrome are active; flow pixel transforms are no longer mistaken for section frames on the wrapper.

Added geometry tests and DOM regressions for canvas peer stability and resize-on-content. 54 renderer tests pass.
